ledger_rows: Calibrate uncertainty / abstention when capability is not identifiable.
scope: exact finite counterfactual capability prediction through five signed resource/requirement margins, plus logical abstention calibration under the already-fitted monotone development-world predictor
assumptions: fixed morphology semantics and capability contracts
repricing changes purchasable capacity as floor(spend/unit_price) under fixed spend
ablation subtracts declared capacity from one registered channel
environmental drift adds declared requirement to one registered obligation channel
no unregistered interaction changes during the perturbation
abstention calibration is logical identifiability under the frozen componentwise monotonicity assumption, not probabilistic confidence calibration
strongest_parent: comparative statics, sensitivity analysis, monotone threshold systems, selective classification with abstention
negative_twin: a perturbation that does not cross the load-bearing margin threshold must not flip the target capability; a query with a monotone witness must not be relabeled CANNOT_IDENTIFY
nearest_counterexample: if repricing changes morphology, ablation triggers compensation, drift changes an unregistered interaction, or componentwise monotonicity fails, margin recomputation and witness-based abstention are insufficient
falsifier: Any registered perturbation case disagrees with the already-fitted development-only predictor or independent exact capability oracle; any non-threshold-crossing negative twin flips its protected target; or CANNOT_IDENTIFY is emitted despite an identifying monotone witness (or omitted when no witness exists).
status: PASS when exact normal and optimized controls agree

abstention_calibration.rule: For target y at query z, emit 1 if any positive development world x satisfies x <= z componentwise; emit 0 if any negative development world x satisfies z <= x componentwise; otherwise emit CANNOT_IDENTIFY.
abstention_calibration.required_control: certificate prediction equals predictor output at all 972 point-target cells; every determinate cell must agree with the independent exact oracle
